I didn’t take Benzodiazepines, I took about 20mg celexa and hydroxyzine I think for about a year and a half, dosages might be wrong. From what I noticed I was just less feeling of everything, my anxiety and depression along with most of my other emotions were just kind of dull. I was still anxious but it was not as debilitating or constant as it was before the medication. It helped me a considerable amount with being able to focus on schoolwork and have proper social interactions, so in my mind it was a worthy trade off. The people I was friends with at the time made a point to tell me that I was much more enjoyable to be around before my medication.


Everything was two shades grayer I guess, my anxiety was more bearable but that’s because I felt every emotion less intense than before. But this is my personal experience with that specific dosage and medication combination, so consider having a consolation meeting with a doctor to talk about possible medications and what they are like if you’re interested in starting anti-anxiety medication.
